equity.equity_measurement: Comparisons are by state and school year only; exemption policy types (philosophical or religious exemptions allowed) are state policy, not an SPD.

notes: States reporting exemptions per vaccine contribute lower-bound estimates; this is a data-handling rule, not a procedure. Potentially achievable coverage is arithmetic (UTD plus nonexempt not UTD). The 95% threshold is used in Results to judge state coverage and achievable coverage.
